short: Shared library, cut by the runes seam
is: The shared library, cut by the seam: `api`/`types`/`components`/`testing` are Effect-free and browser-safe; `server/` is the Effect half.
conventions: `$lib/api/*` is the vocabulary that crosses the seam — plain interfaces + `as const` maps.
A rule stated once lives in the shared module both sides import (`handle-format.ts` backs both the Schema field and the brand validator).
Components name a token, never a raw colour or a palette custom property; core components use the design language's names exactly (`ui/`), and the frame's compositions live in `explorer/`.
Icons are inline SVG path data copied from Lucide (ISC) into `components/ui/icons.ts`, always `aria-hidden` beside words.

A `DenHref` is minted only by the Den path builder (`server/den/den-path.ts`) and the bare-root fallback (`components/explorer/den-root.ts`) — eslint's `no-restricted-imports` enforces it; components render Den links, never build them.

fs.name: api/
fs.role: component-facing plain-data contracts: Problem, Session, Account, Trail (the path bar's steps: a Den link or a fixed section page), the Den view (den.ts: DenPageData, its full shape check isDenPageData, DenOutcome, DenEntry…) and its root route (den-route.ts, pinned to an app with no base path), the sign-out notice (signout.ts: the unconfirmed-sign-out address and its words), HttpStatus, API_PREFIX, FetchFunction

fs.name: components/
fs.role: ProblemNote (the one way a problem renders) + SessionHeader (public pages); `ui/` = the design language's core components by their names (Button, IconButton, Icon, PathBar, Avatar, Dialog, EmptyState, TreeItem, Toggle, Badge, VisibilityMarker, Skeleton); `explorer/` = the signed-in frame's own compositions (AppShell, TopBar, Sidebar, Tree + TreeBranch, ViewOptions, NodeHeader, EntryList, DenPane, ErrorView with its fixed copy in error-copy.ts) and the tree's memory, model and loader

fs.name: server/
fs.role: the Effect half — runtime, API port, programs, form schemas

fs.name: styles/
fs.role: tokens.css (palette → semantic → layout custom properties; dark on :root, light under [data-theme='light'], reduced-motion and more-contrast overrides) + base.css (element defaults, focus ring, .visually-hidden, the one 48rem phone breakpoint behind .desktop-only/.phone-only and --shell-columns); imported once by the root layout

fs.name: testing/
fs.role: spec-only harnesses: fetch stub, problem-body builder, redirect assert, superform prop stub

fs.name: types/
fs.role: branded primitives (brand.ts — the one blessed `as` site: ids, handles, PathSegment, DenHref/DenName/DenType, PageToken) + Effect-free rules shared by both sides (handle-format.ts, segment-format.ts)
